difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled lemma at source lines 787-794, original Lemma 10.2.8: for cardinal numbers alpha, beta, gamma one has alpha<=alpha and (alpha<=beta)->(beta<=gamma)->(alpha<=gamma). It has no author label, so its first-edition number is part of its identity. The proof (source lines 795-801) is short but proceeds by two nested truncation eliminations: the outer one replaces the three cardinals by sets, the inner one extracts the two injections from the truncated inequalities, and the author states at once that both uses are legitimate because the goal is a mere proposition. The statement records the two preorder laws and neither reduction; the author disposes of reflexivity with the remark that it is even easier, the identity injection being the evident witness.
